deadline.value: Each advertised project sets its own deadline; one listed project closes 30 November 2026.

funding.value: Most listed projects are unfunded, so funding depends on the project or a competitive award.

entry_route.value: The stated entry is an honours degree; the University's general page says research applicants normally have a Masters, so check with the department.
entry_route.quote: A first-class or upper second-class Honours degree in a relevant engineering/science discipline, or a suitable equivalent qualification.

also.quote: If you wish to apply for a research degree you'd normally have to have a Masters degree and some experience of research work.

notes: Asks for a recent UKVI-recognised Secure English Language Test (SELT) if English is not the first language, rather than a band score. Mapped from Chemical & Process Engineering to the chemeng field.
